winner.text: Add leakage-safe request-context categorical fields tab, hour, and weekday to the five-field FM baseline.
winner.rationale: This is the highest-evidence candidate: the train-only temporal screen found request context was the only feature group with positive aggregate primary lift (+0.00221), positive lift on all four screened days, and 100% coverage. Downside risks: the daily primary standard deviation (0.00580) exceeds the aggregate lift, so the official gain may be noisy or absent; added context can also overfit short-lived temporal correlations.
winner.exact_ablation: Add exactly three train-vocabulary categorical FM fields—tab, hour derived from impression time, and weekday derived from impression date—while leaving the FM architecture, loss, optimizer, seed, and all existing five fields unchanged.

expected_effect.GAUC: +0.002 to +0.005 from better within-user contextual ordering.
expected_effect.nDCG@5: +0.001 to +0.004 from placing context-appropriate items nearer the top five.

selection_rationale: c01 is the strongest evidence-based choice: request context is the only screened feature family with positive aggregate primary lift (+0.00221), positive lift on all four temporal days, and full coverage. It offers the largest expected primary gain (+0.003) among reliable low-risk options, has low leakage and runtime risk, and is ranked first by the Consultant (utility 0.82). Adding the complete tested bundle is more likely to capture the measured signal than isolated tab, hour, or weekday ablations, while avoiding the unsupported capacity, regularization, and loss changes.
